project.name: TEYUN A8 Study And Integration Plan
project.objective: Create a source-linked, reproducible audio-routing knowledge base for the TEYUN A8 mixer and USB audio-interface capability.

device.category: analog mixer with USB audio-interface capability

goals: Document actual connectors, channel layout, phantom-power scope, and USB endpoint behavior from the physical unit.
Build safe gain-staged routing for Roland XPS-30 and M-VAVE FM-1 audio.
Use the USB interface on Ubuntu only after recording its real ALSA capture and playback behavior.
Keep live, recording, and streaming routing separately documented and reproducible.
